newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Bel-20 to face more mood swings.
newsitem.headline: Bel-20 to face more mood swings.

text.p: The Bel-20 index of leading shares, which quickly slipped into the red after a stronger start on Monday, will see more wild mood swings towards the summer holiday period, dealers said.
"We should consolidate at current levels in the next few days but the market will be pretty volatile," said Patricia Decolvenaer at De Maertelaere.
At 0840 GMT, the Bel-20 was down 0.43 percent at 2,351.45 after rising about 2.5 points to 2,364.17 at the start.
Fourteen Bel-20 shares were lower and just three higher, including retailer Delhaize.

Dealers said Delhaize rose 20 francs to 1,865 on news it was setting up a supermarket chain in Thailand in partnership with local firms. In the same sector Colruyt was unchanged while GIB lost 45 francs.

Solvay lost 75 francs at 21,500 after touching 21,400 earlier, still suffering from a downgrade by Salomon Brothers last Thursday to 'underperform' from 'hold' because of the deterioration in the Belgian chemicals and drugs company's peroxide and plastics outlook.
Chemicals and drugs firm UCB was unchanged at 115,750 francs but exemplified the volatility of the market.

UCB opened 1,250 francs firmer at 117,000, then dropped 750 francs to 115,000 before settling back at Friday's closing level. By 0900 GMT it was up 250 francs again, making it one of five Bel-20 gainers.
